status: proposed UI adapter requirements, not a verified existing API schema

common.asOfInstant: same aggregation snapshot for ranking, own rank and gaps
common.policyId: existing server policy; do not silently replace
common.rankSemantics: existing server tie and ordering policy

rankedEntry.rawMetric: full precision value used by the service
rankedEntry.displayMetric: formatted for UI without changing rank ordering

crew.proposedMetric: weekly valid distance divided by participating runners
crew.zeroParticipantCase: unranked according to service policy; never divide by zero

personal.gap: next raw distance minus own raw distance from same snapshot

points.proposedMetric: points credited in the selected week under current service policy
points.gap: next weekly points minus own weekly points from same scope and snapshot
points.displayUnit: P, grouped integer; adapt to confirmed product unit

uiDerivedValues.rankRise: previousPeriodRank - currentRank; positive rise, negative decline, null if either missing
uiDerivedValues.scopeSwitch: replace list, own rank, neighbors and gap together; ignore stale request responses

implementationBoundary: map current app repositories/services into this UI shape; do not invent endpoint names or replace backend ranking with the currently loaded page index
